title: Power Capital: About
description: John Roberts is a fractional CFO with 16 years as a finance professional — including 15 years at AWS and Amazon.com, from Financial Analyst to Senior Finance Manager.
ogDescription: 16 years as a finance professional, including 15 at AWS and Amazon — meet John Roberts, President of Power Capital.

blocks.heading: Meet our President
blocks.body: A finance partner forged in Amazon's hypergrowth — now bringing that discipline to growing companies as their fractional CFO.

paragraphs.text: John Roberts is a trusted finance partner with 16 years as a finance professional — including 15 years solving large-scale and highly ambiguous problems at AWS and Amazon.com. He has a proven ability to scale alongside Amazon during extreme growth — a period in which the company's market capitalization increased **4,241%, from $56.9B to $2.47T**. That environment demands rigor, speed, and judgment under uncertainty, and it's the foundation John brings to every engagement.,Today, based in Raleigh, North Carolina, John is President of **Power Capital Consulting**, partnering with hyper-scale data center developers and cloud infrastructure investors to sharpen their financial and accounting processes — and bringing that same CFO-level discipline to growing companies.

items.title: President — Power Capital Consulting
items.body: Partners with hyperscale data-center developers (PowerHouse) and cloud-infrastructure investors — designing compliance and audit functions for development costs, leading real-estate development software implementation (Northspyre), and driving scalable, profitable process improvement.

items.title: AWS Accounting Consultant
items.body: Led cross-functional automation projects with CFO sponsorship — full data-center asset-lifecycle automation, controllership for a new power-generator manufacturing process, and accelerating construction timelines for AI-driven mega-campus demand.

items.title: Senior Finance Manager — AWS Infrastructure Finance (BPM)
items.body: Liaison between Finance, Accounting, and technical teams on large-scale projects — for scale, AWS held $108.5B in assets and $24.8B in net PP&E additions in 2023. Exceeded the CFO's goal for fixed-asset PO-coding accuracy with a solution still in use years later.

items.title: Senior Finance Manager — AWS Data Center Infrastructure
items.body: Led the finance team for data-center capex — growing from $1.5B to $3B/yr on AWS's largest commercial cluster, then scaling to lead **global DC capex of $12B/yr** with a team of five.

items.title: Product CFO — AWS Networking (ELB, NAT Gateway, PrivateLink, EC2)
items.body: Full P&L ownership for multiple services generating over $1B in revenue — pricing strategy, multi-year forecasting, and cost-allocation methodology.

items.title: Finance Manager — AWS Server Infrastructure, Supply Chain & Procurement
items.body: Led a team of five supporting multi-billion-dollar server procurement and supply chain (incl. Annapurna) — modeling a multi-billion-dollar server-manufacturing initiative and leading multi-generational CPU pricing negotiations with Intel and others.

items.title: Financial Analyst II — AWS Central FP&A
items.body: Built the automated Weekly Business Review consolidating inputs from thirty-five teams for senior executives — including then-AWS-CEO Andy Jassy.

items.title: Financial Analyst II — Amazon Accounts Receivable, Business Intelligence
items.body: Led the establishment of a global Business Intelligence team, delivering online analytic dashboards and ad hoc reporting across nine countries — driving data-driven insights, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

items.title: Financial Analyst — Amazon Accounts Receivable, Vendor Dispute & Operations
items.body: Led the development and implementation of scalable best practices for processing vendor disputes, managing the transition of vendor dispute work to an offshore team in India — overseeing training, escalations, and work quality for US-based contractors and the Hyderabad team.

blocks.heading: What our experience brings to you.

cards.title: Financial System Design
cards.body: Building the reporting infrastructure and processes that let a company trust its numbers and move fast.

cards.title: Infrastructure & Supply Chain
cards.body: Deep experience in data-center, server infrastructure, and supply chain finance — capital-intensive, operationally complex.

cards.title: Full P&L Ownership
cards.body: Owning the economics of products end to end — from forecasting and pricing to margin and growth.

blocks.heading: Precision is a discipline, not an afterthought.
blocks.body: In data-center and cloud-infrastructure builds, finance isn't bookkeeping — it's protection. We architect the controls, draw schedules, and covenant reporting that keep a project funded and compliant, then translate the numbers into the decisions that keep it moving.

blocks.heading: Let's talk about your business.
blocks.body: Contact us and see what a CFO partner can do for you.
